column2: Writes and changes code in a repository: features, bug fixes, refactors, dependency bumps and tests, for Go and TypeScript.
Answers questions about code you paste: explains behaviour, errors, diffs and stack traces. Does not change a repository.
Summarises documents, transcripts, email threads, reports and articles.
Analyses how events and shocks move commodity and financial markets over years.
Helps the on-call engineer in the first minutes of a production incident or operational alert (outages, errors, latency, capacity).
Researches an open question and writes a structured brief with trade-offs and evidence.
Triages security alerts: suspicious logins, malware, intrusions, phishing; scores risk.
Turns a repository issue into acceptance criteria and a work plan. Writes no code.
Writes the technical design for a ticket: files to change, interfaces, risks. Writes no code.
Implements an approved design on the work branch, runs tests, commits and pushes.
Independently reviews a pushed branch against the ticket criteria and gives a verdict.
Security review of a code change: injection, secrets, authorization, RBAC, dependencies.
Gets a pull request's failing CI checks to pass.
Adversarial review of a pull request: looks for any reason it must not merge.
Merges an approved pull request after verifying checks and the approved commit.
Opens the pull request for an approved work branch and links it on the issue.
